title: Turing LLM Post-Training: Calibrated Distillation and Efficient Dynamic-MoE Execution
abstract: arXiv:2610.39876v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study post-training for dynamically routed mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, focusing on integrating independently optimized specialists while keeping consolidation efficient. Our approach combines calibrated multi-teacher on-policy distillation (C-MOPD), which matches each selected teacher on a local Top-$K$ support with teacher-wise loss normalization and clipping, with an execution path that uses post-capacity bounded-width dispatch, final-route replay, and asynchronous rollout--training overlap. On Turing-20B-A2B, the selected model achieves a four-domain normalized integration score of 0.9988 and retains at least 90.16\% of the measured specialist gain in every domain. At matched $K=32$, the full calibration objective scores 0.9962, compared with 0.9724 without calibration and 0.9834 without clipping. translated_title: 图灵大语言模型后训练：校准蒸馏与高效的动态MoE执行
translated_abstract: 我们研究动态路由的专家混合模型的后训练方法，重点关注如何在保持整合高效的同时集成独立优化的专家模型。我们的方法将校准多教师在线策略蒸馏（C-MOPD）与一种高效执行路径相结合：C-MOPD在每个选定教师的局部Top-K支持集上进行匹配，并采用按教师分别的损失归一化与裁剪；执行路径则采用容量后有界宽度分发、最终路由重放以及异步推演-训练重叠机制。在Turing-20B-A2B模型上，所选模型达到了0.9988的四领域归一化整合得分，并在每个领域保留了至少90.16%的实测专家增益。在匹配的K=32条件下，完整校准目标得分为0.9962，相比之下无校准时为0.9724、无裁剪时为0.9834。在匹配的8K响应上限下，该模型在所有四个需要推理的数学与代码基准（摘要在此处截断）上均超过了共享SFT和Qwen3-8B。
tldr: 该论文提出校准多教师在线策略蒸馏（C-MOPD）结合高效动态MoE执行路径，在Turing-20B-A2B上实现近乎完美的专家模型整合（四域归一化得分0.9988），并在数学与代码推理基准上超越Qwen3-8B。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes calibrated multi-teacher on-policy distillation (C-MOPD) combined with an efficient dynamic-MoE execution path, achieving near-perfect specialist integration on Turing-20B-A2B (0.9988 normalized four-domain score) and outperforming Qwen3-8B on math and code reasoning benchmarks.
